zh: 住所；住房；（尤指）宅第，豪宅
en: a house, especially a large or impressive one
ex: a desirable family residence for sale (= for example, in an advertisement)
待售的理想家居

en: a building for university or college students to live in

zh: （艺术家、作家、音乐家为某机构工作的）驻留时间，驻留期
高级专科住院医生实习期
en: permission to live in a country that is not your own
ex: She has been granted permanent residency in Britain.
她获准在英国永久居住。

zh: （美国的）高级专科住院实习医生
en: a person who lives in a particular place or who has their home there
ex: a resident of the United States
美国的居民

zh: （获准在美国居留的）外籍居民，外侨
en: a person from another country who has permission to stay in the US

zh: 需要在某地居住的；提供住宿的
en: suitable for living in; consisting of houses rather than factories or offices
ex: a quiet residential area
安静的住宅区

zh: 居民委员会；居民联合会
en: a group of people who live in a particular area and join together to discuss the problems of that area
left at the end of a process
ex: There are still a few residual problems with the computer program.
电脑程序还有一些残留问题。

en: left from the money and property of a person who has died after all debts, gifts, etc. have been paid
ex: a residuary bequest
遗赠

en: a small amount of something that remains at the end of a process
ex: pesticide residues in fruit and vegetables
残留在水果和蔬菜中的杀虫剂

zh: （化学反应的）残基，残渣，残留物；（某种进程的）残体
en: something that remains after a reaction or process has taken place
to officially tell somebody that you are leaving your job, an organization, etc.
ex: She was forced to resign due to ill health.
由于身体不好，她被迫辞职。
